instruction: A candid documentary wide shot of an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet, white walls, and wooden flooring in the background. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right. On the right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing left, reaching her left hand to touch his right shoulder. The room is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
